limitations: One training seed; no repeated-seed uncertainty estimate.
Existing public labels simulate a human oracle; annotation time is not measured.
The initial model is already near the test accuracy ceiling; no accuracy or macro-F1 gain was observed.
The arms share validation/test examples; acquisition uses only the remaining training pool.

protocol.label_source: simulated oracle using existing dataset labels
protocol.retraining: fresh identical pretrained initialization and seed for every arm
protocol.selection: lowest maximum softmax probability; image-key tie break
protocol.test_policy: unchanged held-out test, evaluated only after all arms are frozen
